coverage: Country-specific, evidence-backed horror cinema release and screening diary; a venue or distributor listing does not guarantee showtimes at every cinema. Territory date conflicts are explicitly flagged; unconfirmed reach is never described as a general release. 2027 UK dates drawn from advance film calendars are provisional, not venue bookings.
priorityPolicy: Group by month first; within a month source-confirmed major studio/general releases first, special re-screenings next and select independent cinema events last. Months always remain in chronological order.
